set.body: From the UI-G G1 review (2026-09-26). Case classes with private apply/copy/new can still be built via the public Mirror: DataRecord.fromProduct(Tuple1(0)) returns DataRecord(0), bypassing the smart constructor (rule 1), and CsvRecord.fromProduct(Tuple1(0)).role yields DataRecord(-1). The same hole exists in about 17 other files with private-constructor case classes. Options: make such types plain final classes with explicit equals/hashCode/toString, or pin the hole with a typeCheckErrors or known-gap test. A house-wide decision, then a sweep.
set.title: Private-constructor case classes are still constructible through Mirror fromProduct
